definitions.explanation: Benefits and services provided by an employer for employee welfare.

examples.japanese: {福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}が{充実|じゅうじつ}している{会社|かいしゃ}だ。
examples.english: It's a company with comprehensive employee benefits.

examples.japanese: {福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}の{一環|いっかん}として{保養所|ほようじょ}がある。
examples.english: As part of employee benefits, there's a company resort.

examples.japanese: {福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}を{重視|じゅうし}する。
{転職|てんしょく}する{時|とき}は、{給料|きゅうりょう}だけでなく{福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}も{確認|かくにん}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: When changing jobs, you should check not only the salary but also the employee benefits.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}{制度|せいど}として、{社員|しゃいん}{食堂|しょくどう}やスポーツジムの{利用|りよう}ができる。
examples.english: This company offers an employee cafeteria and gym access as part of its benefits program.

notes:
{福利厚生|ふくりこうせい} refers to employee benefits and welfare programs provided by companies.

WORD FORMATION:
{福利|ふくり} (welfare, benefit) + {厚生|こうせい} (welfare, well-being)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}が{充実|じゅうじつ}している: has comprehensive benefits
- {福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}{制度|せいど}: benefits system
- {福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}{施設|しせつ}: welfare facilities

TYPICAL BENEFITS:
- {健康|けんこう}{保険|ほけん}: health insurance
- {厚生|こうせい}{年金|ねんきん}: employee pension
- {社宅|しゃたく}: company housing
- {保養所|ほようじょ}: company resort/retreat
- {育児|いくじ}{支援|しえん}: childcare support

USAGE:
Common in job listings and HR contexts. An important factor when job hunting in Japan. Sometimes abbreviated to {福利|ふくり}.
